discovery.input: Already-admitted landing/distribution snapshot; no fetch, browser, credentials or policy duplication
discovery.links: Exact linked URL including query selectors; same configured publisher host only. Operation-list and code-sheet successor links retained. Historical 2014-2020 and Art.42 monitoring/financial-report links excluded from operation list discovery.
discovery.cursor: Admitted HTML page URL; rel=next produces a GET resource reference and partial coverage. Cursor not matching current admitted page is held. Never guess date filenames/download IDs.
discovery.completion: Landing discovery is partial even without rel=next because it cannot certify operation-row completeness. A landing with no matching links is empty discovery, never an operation withdrawal.

parsing.identity: Operation subject includes publisher, catalog source ID and native operation ID. Native leading zeroes preserved. sourceVersion binds observations/evidence, never renumbers the operation subject. Duplicate operation/payment keys suppress all ambiguous occurrences.
parsing.programme: Attributed authority/fund/period/code descriptor. Native fields preferred; catalog authority/fund/period defaults explicitly qualified. Missing CCI/programme code stays null and marks incomplete programme identity; no confirmed cross-source programme merge.
parsing.amounts: Decimal strings normalized without floating-point multiplication. Original numeric/string lexeme retained in primary evidence. Total/eligible cost, approved grant and EU amount remain approval, never payout/actual expenditure. Numeric percent-styled OOXML/SpreadsheetML values scale exactly by 100 using nativePercentValue; builtin numFmtId 9/10 and unquoted custom % are style evidence, never a value<=1 or CSV/header scaling guess. Quoted/escaped literal %, strings and General numeric values remain unscaled. A percent header or explicit percent character can identify the unit without causing scaling. Unsupported/contradictory monetary/date/percentage styles hold. Without a percent unit/style, a rate remains source_rate.
parsing.dates: Explicit source date headers only. OOXML numeric serials require a true derived native date style and use the workbook epoch; General numeric years/values are held rather than fabricated as 1905/etc calendar serial dates. Exact style and date1904 metadata is retained as source_metadata supportingEvidence. Nonexistent Excel 1900-02-29 remains held. Start/end dates retain operation_start/operation_end roles and do not prove commissioning/completion. Cutoff/publication/retrieval are separate and unknown metadata remains null.
parsing.geography: Native eight-digit AGS preserved only when explicitly disclosed in role-specific source column; malformed/lost leading zeroes held. SAME ROW AGS des Vorhabens propagates project_location to operation amounts, dates, programme-attribution fields and beneficiary relationships, with the original AGS cell/header added to each affected observation's evidence. This is geographic context of the operation assertion, not a claim locating the whole programme or beneficiary. Beneficiary mention/type facts remain unknown geography; office geography remains separately typed and never propagates to operation facts. NUTS/name/postcode stays a raw location indicator with null AGS and unknown basis. Scope AGS is never projected onto state/national rows; BLE annual payments never acquire inferred project geography.
parsing.privacy: Native legal status/type is primary and any explicit natural/private-person status vetoes fallback. When status is absent or explicitly unknown, only a complete token-bounded terminal legal-form assertion in the exact mapped beneficiary-name column can support an attributed source-scoped legal-organization mention. Never arbitrary titles, generic public-body words or canonical identity inference. Free descriptions, contact and street-address fields omitted. Beneficiary office municipality remains separately typed geography, not a street address or operation site.

recipientFallback.boundary: Complete terminal form separated from preceding name by whitespace/comma; no substring matches, bare AG/KG/OHG/SE, generic Stadt/Amt/Verein/Unternehmen words, or suffix plus in-Gründung/personal/title text.
recipientFallback.basis: recipient_type_basis distinguishes source_native_legal_status and source_asserted_legal_form. Fallback also emits recipient_legal_form with exact native beneficiary-name evidence. Canonical legal identity remains unknown and source-scoped mention IDs are not registry identifiers.
recipientFallback.publicBodies: Without native legal type, public bodies require an externally verified publisher/source/native-beneficiary→public-body join with original structured evidence and AGS. Current API supplies no join; generic municipal-name matching stays held.

parsing.codes: Native code/label rows in explicitly contextualized code/legend sheets produce FundingCodeDefinition observations with raw code/label evidence. No unstated code crosswalk, fund conversion or municipal join. Code-only snapshot is partial operation coverage, not an awarded operation list.
parsing.evidence: Original exact-byte hash + original format + sheet/logical CSV row or HTML table/row/cell + raw field and header values + schemaHash + mappingVersion. CSV coordinates are parser logical records after BOM/optional sep directive, not physical text-line numbers; quoted newlines stay in original decoded field. No invented prose/model provenance.
parsing.holds: Whole-file/native parse failures and changed/missing/duplicate semantic headers remain held_quality and emit no observations. Independently row-local malformed dates/decimal/AGS, unknown/missing fund/ID, explicit private/person or otherwise unqualified recipient type, conflicting period and duplicate native keys exclude every affected row. If validated independent observations remain, coverage is honestly partial with explicit held-row count/reason and total observed-row count, never complete; otherwise held_quality. No facts from a partially valid held row are emitted, and duplicate keys suppress every ambiguous occurrence without suppressing unrelated proven rows. External rights/geography/source admission rules are unchanged.
parsing.withdrawal: Explicit native withdrawn/revoked status emits only a source_status tombstone. Disappearance/empty/partial page never implies deletion.

sharedPrimitives.tableShape: NativeTable {format: csv|xlsx|xls, sheet: string|null, rows: NativeCell[][], date1904: boolean}. XLSX/SpreadsheetML rows and cells are sparse at original zero-based indices. NativeCell {address,raw,type: string|number|boolean|date,dateStyle,numberFormat?}. Numeric raw is original lexeme, never replaced by rendered/display value.

numberFormat.ooxml: Effective style precedence is explicit cell@s (including0), active row@s when customFormat1/true, applicable column@style, then style0. False/absent customFormat does not activate a row default. Original cell/row activation and column min/max/style attributes are retained as native selection evidence; raw numeric lexemes never change. Column ranges are positive native indices through16384 and lookup remains bounded to the admitted512-column reader width. Invalid style references, flags/ranges, active row defaults lacking an index, and actually used conflicting styled overlaps hold rather than assuming General. Explicit cells and active row defaults override valid conflicting column declarations. Numeric effective formats outside the supported native number-format mapping also hold, never silently become General. Effective cellXfs numFmtId and cellStyleXfs inheritance, native custom numFmt formatCode and workbookPr/@date1904 remain evidence-backed.
numberFormat.spreadsheetml: Native Cell/Row/Column/Table ss:StyleID precedence and Style ss:Parent/Default inheritance are retained; NumberFormat/@ss:Format and ExcelWorkbook/Date1904 have source-field locators. General numeric values are not dates. Native Data ss:Type DateTime remains distinct from numeric serial conversion.
numberFormat.percent: nativePercentValue(cell):string returns raw.trim unchanged except numeric cells whose effective numberFormat.percentStyle is true; those shift the decimal exactly two positions. Builtin9/10, unquoted custom % and native SpreadsheetML Percent define scaling. Quoted/escaped literal %, string/marker cells and General numeric values do not scale. No magnitude/header heuristic.
numberFormat.receipts: Style metadata is source_metadata supportingEvidence with original snapshot hash, actual XLSX/XLS member/XML path, raw scalar attribute, sheet/rowKey null and cells[]. It is never mislabeled as the original value cell or synthesized prose. Native value-cell raw evidence remains unchanged.

sharedPrimitives.explicitOverrides: readZip(bytes, Partial<ZipLimits>) and readCsv(bytes, {delimiter,encoding,limits:Partial<CsvLimits>}). Defaults preserved; effective bounds must be contract/receipt bound by caller.
sharedPrimitives.security: In-memory only; no filesystem/subprocess/network. ZIP CRC, central/local binding, traversal, symlink, duplicate names, overlap, encryption and expansion bounded. ZIP64/multidisk/unsupported compression held. XML DTD/entities and external OOXML workbook/resource relationships rejected. Only exact known hyperlink relationship types may be ignored without fetching or emitting target data; this does not permit external workbook links, entities or archive escapes. Formula/error cells require a separate checked interpretation rather than trusted cached values.
sharedPrimitives.legacyXls: Excel 2003 SpreadsheetML XML supported by readSpreadsheetXml; binary OLE/BIFF and HTML masquerading as XLS are not mislabeled operational.
sharedPrimitives.schemaConvention: Unknown/unsupported formats and bounds throw; adapter converts to held_quality, not silently empty/truncated.

integration: Bind fundingCapabilityReceipt.nativeNumberFormatVersion and the shared native-number-format-v2 interpretation contract in semantic job/cache identity; funding ontology/mapping remains funding-operations-v2. Same-source style/epoch locators bind the whole original archive/document SHA256 and use its current primary admission, never synthetic member policies.
Register fundingOperationsAdapter for all seven catalog source IDs and expose fundingCapabilityReceipt without counting held/unverified sources as operational.
Acquisition owner must resolve distribution-specific rights/origin and provide exact-byte admission; this module never forks owner policy or collects live data.
Execute parsers only in credential-free, network-denied isolation; in-memory native readers do not remove executor isolation requirement.
Retain source-version and original CAS bytes for field/schema re-verification; admission/policy proof binding belongs to shared representation/receipt owner.
Keep financial event role, geography role, date role and incomplete programme identity in downstream records/graph; no inferred same_as, current validity, payout, completion or location equality.

Actual publisher byte fixtures and source-specific native-status or narrowly explicit legal-form assertion qualification required before admitting live rows; unqualified recipient types remain held and source-scoped mentions never become canonical identity by name equality.
SH ESF requires real PDF/table text locator and checked semantic extraction; BLE requires actual accessible admitted native distribution and retention/access/schema qualification.
Reuse structured-tables.ts exports across MaStR/statistics/census/education/GENESIS/GTFS/procurement rather than local OOXML/ZIP tokenizers.
